## Generals Mobile v125 hotfix

### Critical fix
- Fixes the v124 startup regression that could end in the generic `Technical Difficulties` dialog while loading `Data\INI\CommandSet.ini`.
- Restores the v123 base-game directory enumeration behavior so Zero Hour BIG/INI precedence is no longer changed by the new mod-folder feature.
- Keeps mod-only recursive discovery isolated from vanilla base-game archive enumeration.

### What the device logs showed
On the affected v124 launch, the same `Data\INI\Science.ini` was processed as 155 lines instead of the 263 lines seen in the working previous build. That caused cascades of `Science ... not recognized` warnings and eventually `CommandSet.ini` failed on field `6`. v125 fixes the archive-order regression at its source rather than suppressing the parser error.

### Preserved from v124
- Vulkan/DXVK, native GLES3 and GLES3 via ANGLE renderer selection.
- Secondary mod-folder launcher and loose-file override support.
- Mod BIG archives still load after the base archives with overwrite priority.
- Performance/rendering improvements imported from MYSOREZ v1.2.0.

### Validation
Android CI run #10 completed successfully on source commit ed4cc7984f5cc08a914597f4f5757f07730a413e, including native build, artifact verification, APK packaging and DT_NEEDED verification. The fix was derived directly from an on-device v124/v123 log comparison using the same game-data folder.

The APK contains engine code only. You must provide game data from a legally owned copy of Command & Conquer: Generals - Zero Hour.
